oneLine: DealShare CEO steps down as the e-commerce unicorn enters acquisition talks.

sources.title: DealShare CEO Kamaldeep Singh Steps Down Amid Acquisition Talks

synopsis: Ecommerce unicorn DealShare is in advanced discussions with online pharmacy Truemeds for a potential acquisition via a share-swap transaction. The proposed deal could value DealShare at just over $90 Mn, marking a 95% drop from its peak valuation of $1.7 Bn achieved in 2022. DealShare is also reportedly exploring talks with other potential buyers amid leadership departures, including CEO Kamaldeep Singh stepping down to join Indofast Energy, and a scaled-down online business. WestBridge holds roughly 18.4% of DealShare, which has raised nearly $400 Mn to date from investors including WestBridge Capital, Z47, Tiger Global, and Alpha Wave Global. The transaction is not yet finalized, with Truemeds' existing investors not necessarily aligned.
